name: GitHub Copilot
intro: GitHub Copilot sends your code to GitHub's servers, limits you to the models it offers and charges monthly once you outgrow the free plan. The tools below let you pick your own model, host the server yourself or run a model locally.

freeTier.answer: Yes. GitHub Copilot has a Free plan with a monthly usage limit. See GitHub's official pricing page for details.

name: Claude Code
intro: Claude Code only runs on Anthropic's models and is not released under an open-source license. The terminal agents below have public source code, and most let you switch model providers.

name: ChatGPT
intro: ChatGPT stores conversations on OpenAI's servers and only uses OpenAI's models. The apps below run on your computer or server and connect to local models or many other providers.

freeTier.answer: Yes. ChatGPT has a free plan with limits on models and usage. See OpenAI's pricing page for details.

name: LM Studio
intro: LM Studio is free but not open source: you cannot inspect how it handles data, modify it or repackage it. The tools below also run models locally, with public source code.

freeTier.answer: Yes. LM Studio is free for personal and work use, but the app's source code is not public. See the official site for terms.

name: Midjourney
intro: Midjourney only runs on its own servers, charges a monthly plan and limits how much you can steer the generation process. The tools below run open-weight models such as Stable Diffusion on your GPU.
